# Dormroom Studios

> Dormroom Studios is a three-person independent game studio in India. Its first title is Neon Fragments, a single-player cyberpunk-noir first-person shooter coming to Steam (Windows) on 25 February 2027.

## Facts

- Studio: Dormroom Studios, India, team of three
- Contact: hello@dormroom.in
- Studio site: https://dormroom.in/
- Game: Neon Fragments
- Game site: https://neonfragments.com/ (its own summary is at https://neonfragments.com/llms.txt)
- Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641020/Neon_Fragments/
- Gameplay trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BytSgDMmVEI
- Release: 25 February 2027, Steam, Windows
- Events: playable demo at gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show, 30 October to 1 November 2026, indie area, Entertainment halls, QSNCC Bangkok: https://neonfragments.com/gamescom-asia-2026/

## Pages

- [Home](https://dormroom.in/): about the studio, the game, contact.
